0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets are 7-2 in their 10th game of the 2026-27 season and sit 1st in the Southwest, but they dropped their most recent game. The Phoenix Suns are 1-5 and have lost four straight, sitting 12th in the West. Houston will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Phoenix will be without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, and Houston won all four of their 2025-26 meetings, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
